title: vaoXR 0.1.0

creators.name: Ukolov, Dominik
creators.affiliation: Digital Humanities (Image/Object), Friedrich Schiller University Jena; Research Group DIGITAL ORGANOLOGY, Leipzig University

description:
vaoXR is an installable web application for exploring a historic positive organ through its linked 3D model, recordings, sampled stops, and performance animation. It implements a reader for Virtual Acoustic Object (VAO) Standard 0.5.0.

Version 0.1.0 includes a 3D viewer with audio-clock-driven key animation, four room-listening positions, a 45-note sampled manual with five selectable stops and VAO-defined sustain loops, markerless mobile augmented reality, and a dedicated Meta Quest 3 passthrough experience. Quest supports controller-based scale and light controls and experimental direct hand interaction with keys and stops. The progressive web app provides an offline shell, optional sample-pack downloads, and browser capability guidance.

This record archives the software source. The demo instrument release is version 0.5.0-2; its version and the VAO standard version are independent of the software version. Large instrument media and Unity source assets are not included in this software archive. A supplied setup script downloads the pinned demo assets separately and verifies their byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Source media and bundled third-party software retain their respective rights and notices.

Original application code is licensed under Apache License 2.0. Original documentation is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). NOTICE defines the file-level scope; third-party code and source-specific instrument data retain their own rights and notices.

Requirements: Node.js 22.13 or newer and Python 3.11 or newer. The repository includes a lockfile, automated tests, pinned VAO validation tools, and a standalone Node/Docker deployment configuration. Physical-device behavior, native phone AR capabilities, and experimental Quest hand interaction depend on the device and browser.

Live application: https://vaoxr.modavis.org. Source and release: vaoXR v0.1.0 on GitHub. See README.md, CITATION.cff, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the archive for setup, citation, and source-specific rights.
notes: The archive contains the tagged vaoXR 0.1.0 source snapshot. SHA256SUMS provides its SHA-256 digest. The primary software license is Apache-2.0; original documentation is CC-BY-4.0, with scope and exceptions in NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The instrument dataset and the VAO standard have separate versions and identifiers.
